import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Inspect schemas:
# df_source0 columns: ['PLAYER', '2017-18']
# df_source1 columns: ['#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']

# Target schema:
# ['PLAYER': string, '2017-18': integer, '#': integer, 'Player': string, 'Team': string, 'GP': integer, 'MPG': float, 'FGM': float, 'FGA': float, 'FG%': float, '3PM': float, '3PA': float, '3P%': float, 'FTM': float, 'FTA': float, 'FT%': float, 'TOV': float, 'PF': float, 'ORB': float, 'DRB': float, 'RPG': float, 'APG': float, 'SPG': float, 'BPG': float, 'PPG': float]

# Transformation plan:
# - df_source0 contains PLAYER and 2017-18 (salary)
# - df_source1 contains detailed stats keyed by Player (name)
# - PLAYER in source0 and Player in source1 represent the same player name, so join on PLAYER=Player
# - After join, keep all columns from source1 plus PLAYER and 2017-18 from source0
# - PLAYER and Player columns both exist in target, keep both as is
# - The '#' column is integer in source1, keep as is
# - Ensure data types match target schema
# - Write final dataframe to target path

# Join on PLAYER (source0) = Player (source1)
df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, left_on='PLAYER', right_on='Player', how='inner')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['PLAYER', '2017-18', '#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Enforce data types according to target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'PLAYER': str,
    '2017-18': 'int64',
    '#': 'int64',
    'Player': str,
    'Team': str,
    'GP': 'int64',
    'MPG': 'float64',
    'FGM': 'float64',
    'FGA': 'float64',
    'FG%': 'float64',
    '3PM': 'float64',
    '3PA': 'float64',
    '3P%': 'float64',
    'FTM': 'float64',
    'FTA': 'float64',
    'FT%': 'float64',
    'TOV': 'float64',
    'PF': 'float64',
    'ORB': 'float64',
    'DRB': 'float64',
    'RPG': 'float64',
    'APG': 'float64',
    'SPG': 'float64',
    'BPG': 'float64',
    'PPG': 'float64'
})

# Output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"

# Write to CSV without the index
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
